(8) He participates in physical tests, including a standing long jump on a blue mat and a mobility test with a wooden staff. (9) Night relay race: the man runs his leg under stadium lights. Teammates cheer from the sidelines. The video ends with the team celebrating their third-place finish with high-fives and cheers.
